sourceModelNote: Source GLB is READ ONLY here -- never modified, decimated, or overwritten. It is a right-hand HALF car; this bake mirrors a FULL-RESOLUTION (undecimated) copy about world X=0 (same plane as src/car.js's runtime mirror) to build the full-car collision volume.

decimation.method: none -- full resolution (see docstring: 'Solid voxelisation, decimation reconsidered' -- decimating a convex surface shrinks it inside its true envelope, and wasn't buying meaningful bake-time savings at this mesh/pitch anyway)

mirror.method: negate vertex.x, reverse face winding [0,2,1] to keep outward normals
mirror.note: Matches src/car.js's runtime mirror plane. Mirroring the whole half-mesh (rather than re-deriving car.js's per-component RIGHT_ONLY_COMPONENTS name list in Python) is equivalent: the small already-symmetric parts documented in PROGRESS.md Phase 1 mirror onto themselves and contribute no new geometry, so the result is the same full-car shape.

grid.method: SOLID: trimesh surface voxelisation (method='subdivide') -> 1x binary dilation (inflate ~half a voxel, the discrete form a grid can represent) -> VoxelGrid.fill(method='holes') to flood-fill the interior. Replaces the previous hollow-shell-only bake -- see docstring 'Solid voxelisation, decimation reconsidered' for why.

normals.method: area-weighted average of face normals within an expanding search radius (base radius = 1.5x pitch, doubled up to 6x if nothing usable is found), falling back to nearest single face as a last resort

flowDomain.note: Re-derived from the RAW undecimated half-car scene graph using the same axis/sign heuristic as src/particles/domain.js (longer horizontal bbox axis = flow axis; compare avg world position of /front/i vs /rear|back/i named nodes along that axis). Bounds below are the full mirrored car at FULL mesh resolution (not the decimated collision copy), for accurate flow-domain sizing.

binaryFormat.normalUnits: unit vector, points away from the occupied surface (outward)
